We don't currently allow lookups into a devmap from eBPF
lookup returns a pointer directly to the dev->ifindex

column2: being able to do lookups in devmaps is useful to know (e.g.)

column1: whether forwarding to a specific interface is enabled. Currently
work around this by keeping a shadow map of another type which indicates
whether a map index is valid.
Since we now have a flag to make maps read-only from the eBPF side
simply lift the lookup restriction if we make sure this flag is always set.
